title: Associativity and unit of transported scalar multiplication
statement: Let U and V be schemes [def-pc-scheme], f : U → V, and O a commutative ring sheaf on the small etale site of V [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. Let L be the set inverse image, assumed to preserve finite limits, La the fixed abelian inverse image, and Lr any left adjoint to the sectionwise ring direct image. Write FrU, FrV and FaU, FaV for the respective underlying-set functors. Assume natural isomorphisms er : Lr ⋙ FrU ≅ FrV ⋙ L and ea : La ⋙ FaU ≅ FaV ⋙ L, and assume that both ring and abelian adjunction hom equivalences commute with the set adjunction through er and ea, as in [lem-weil-pbc-etale-inverse-image-algebraic-structures]. For any O-module sheaf G [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], write FV(G) for its abelian sheaf, A = La(FV(G)), and OR for the ring sheaf underlying Lr(O). Let muV : FrV(O) × FaV(FV(G)) → FaV(FV(G)) be any sheaf morphism whose section values are the scalar action of G applied to its two product projections. Define mu by prod.map(er.hom(O),ea.hom(FV(G))), then the inverse product comparison for L, then L(muV), then ea.inv(FV(G)). Let e be the canonical isomorphism from the categorical product FrU(Lr(O)) × FaU(A) to the chosen sectionwise product of these sheaves, determined by the product projections. Set act_W(r,x) = (e.inv ≫ mu)_W(r,x). For every object W of the small etale site of U, r,s in OR(W), and x in A(W), act_W(r*s,x) = act_W(r,act_W(s,x)) and act_W(1,x) = x. No distributivity law is asserted.

proof.text: Obtain the canonical ring and abelian lifts and their multiplication and one transport equations from lem-weil-pbc-etale-inverse-image-algebraic-structures. Identify the supplied comparisons with the canonical ones using the hom equivalence equations and uniqueness of left adjoints.

Write the source associativity diagram on (O times O) times G, multiplying scalars on one side and iterating the scalar action on the other. Write the source unit diagram on G, inserting the constant one and then applying muV. These hold sectionwise by the formula for muV and the source module axioms.

Apply L to the diagrams. Naturality of its invertible binary and triple product comparisons and the multiplication transport formula give the associativity diagram for mu. Preservation of the terminal object and the one transport formula give its unit diagram. Cancel comparison isomorphisms and evaluate at ((r,s),x) and x; use e to compare categorical products with sectionwise products.

theorem etaleInverseImageScalarAssociativity (U V : Scheme.{u}) (f : U ⟶ V)
    (O : Sheaf V.smallEtaleTopology CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    [PreservesFiniteLimits (Scheme.etaleSetPullback f)] :
    let L := Scheme.etaleSetPullback f
    let La := Etale.upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f
    let a := Etale.upperStarLowerStarAdjunction AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f
    let FaU := sheafForget (D := AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) U.smallEtaleTopology
    let FaV := sheafForget (D := AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) V.smallEtaleTopology
    let FrU := sheafForget (D := CommRingCat.{u + 1}) U.smallEtaleTopology
    let FrV := sheafForget (D := CommRingCat.{u + 1}) V.smallEtaleTopology
    let b := MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ f
    let aS := Functor.sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafAdjunctionContinuous b
      (Type (u + 1)) (V.smallGrothendieckTopology @Etale)
      (U.smallGrothendieckTopology @Etale)
    let Rr := b.sheafPushforwardContinuous CommRingCat.{u + 1}
      (V.smallGrothendieckTopology @Etale) (U.smallGrothendieckTopology @Etale)
    ∀ (Lr : Sheaf V.smallEtaleTopology CommRingCat.{u + 1} ⥤
        Sheaf U.smallEtaleTopology CommRingCat.{u + 1})
      (ar : Lr ⊣ Rr) (er : Lr ⋙ FrU ≅ FrV ⋙ L),
    let OR := (sheafCompose U.smallEtaleTopology
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1})).obj (Lr.obj O)
    let OV := (sheafCompose V.smallEtaleTopology
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1})).obj O
    let FV := SheafOfModules.toSheaf.{u + 1} OV
    ∀ (ea : La ⋙ FaU ≅ FaV ⋙ L),
      (∀ (G : Sheaf V.smallEtaleTopology CommRingCat.{u + 1})
          (F : Sheaf U.smallEtaleTopology CommRingCat.{u + 1}) (h : Lr.obj G ⟶ F),
        FrV.map (ar.homEquiv G F h) =
          aS.homEquiv (FrV.obj G) (FrU.obj F) (er.inv.app G ≫ FrU.map h)) ∧
      (∀ (G : Sheaf V.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
          (F : Sheaf U.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (h : La.obj G ⟶ F),
        FaV.map (a.homEquiv G F h) =
          aS.homEquiv (FaV.obj G) (FaU.obj F) (ea.inv.app G ≫ FaU.map h)) →
    ∀ G : SheafOfModules.{u + 1} OV,
    ∀ muV : (FrV.obj O) ⨯ (FaV.obj (FV.obj G)) ⟶ (FaV.obj (FV.obj G)),
      (∀ (W : V.Etaleᵒᵖ) (x : ((FrV.obj O) ⨯ (FaV.obj (FV.obj G))).obj.obj W),
        muV.hom.app W x =
          @SMul.smul (O.obj.obj W) (G.val.obj W) (G.val.obj W).isModule.toSMul
            ((prod.fst : (FrV.obj O) ⨯ (FaV.obj (FV.obj G)) ⟶
              FrV.obj O).hom.app W x : O.obj.obj W)
            ((prod.snd : (FrV.obj O) ⨯ (FaV.obj (FV.obj G)) ⟶
              FaV.obj (FV.obj G)).hom.app W x : G.val.obj W)) →
    let A := La.obj (FV.obj G)
    let mu := prod.map (er.hom.app O) (ea.hom.app (FV.obj G)) ≫
      inv (prodComparison L (FrV.obj O) (FaV.obj (FV.obj G))) ≫
      L.map muV ≫ ea.inv.app (FV.obj G)
    let e : (FrU.obj (Lr.obj O)) ⨯ (FaU.obj A) ≅
        (FrU.obj (Lr.obj O)) ⊗ (FaU.obj A) :=
      (limit.isLimit _).conePointUniqueUpToIso
        (CartesianMonoidalCategory.tensorProductIsBinaryProduct _ _)
    let act : ∀ W : U.Etaleᵒᵖ, OR.obj.obj W → A.obj.obj W → A.obj.obj W :=
      fun W r x ↦ (e.inv ≫ mu).hom.app W (r, x)
    ∀ W : U.Etaleᵒᵖ,
      (∀ (r s : OR.obj.obj W) (x : A.obj.obj W),
        act W (r * s) x = act W r (act W s x)) ∧
      (∀ x : A.obj.obj W, act W 1 x = x)
